sub_graphs.title: Capella: Validator Withdrawal Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of validator withdrawals from eligibility determination through execution payload inclusion and balance updates

nodes.label: Validator Eligible for Full Withdrawal
nodes.description: Validator has eth1 withdrawal credentials, reached withdrawable epoch, and has balance > 0

nodes.label: Validator Eligible for Partial Withdrawal
nodes.description: Validator has eth1 credentials, effective balance at MAX_EFFECTIVE_BALANCE, and excess balance available

nodes.label: Sweep Validators for Withdrawals
nodes.description: Iterate through up to MAX_VALIDATORS_PER_WITHDRAWALS_SWEEP (16384) validators starting from next_withdrawal_validator_index to find eligible withdrawals

nodes.label: Expected Withdrawals Computed
nodes.description: Up to MAX_WITHDRAWALS_PER_PAYLOAD (16) withdrawals have been determined for inclusion

nodes.label: Apply Withdrawals to State
nodes.description: Decrease validator balances for each withdrawal and update next_withdrawal_index and next_withdrawal_validator_index

nodes.label: Withdrawals Applied to Beacon State
nodes.description: Validator balances decreased, withdrawal indices advanced, funds sent to execution layer addresses

edges.label: Full withdrawal candidate found during sweep
Partial withdrawal candidate found during sweep

sub_graphs.title: Capella: BLS-to-Execution Credential Change
sub_graphs.description: Models the security-critical process of migrating withdrawal credentials from BLS keys to execution layer addresses

nodes.label: Validator Has BLS Withdrawal Credentials
nodes.description: Validator withdrawal credentials use 0x00 BLS prefix, cannot receive automatic withdrawals

nodes.label: Validate BLS-to-Execution Change Message
nodes.description: Verify: validator exists, current credentials use BLS prefix, pubkey hash matches credential bytes 1-31, BLS signature is valid using fork-agnostic domain

nodes.label: Credential Change Validated
nodes.description: BLS-to-execution change message passed all validation checks

nodes.label: Update Withdrawal Credential
nodes.description: Replace credential prefix from 0x00 to 0x01 and set execution address in bytes 12-31

nodes.label: Validator Has Execution Withdrawal Credentials
nodes.description: Validator withdrawal credentials now use 0x01 eth1 prefix with execution address, eligible for automatic withdrawals

edges.label: Credential irreversibly changed to eth1 prefix

external_entities.name: Validator Operator
external_entities.description: Entity holding the BLS withdrawal key, submitting credential change requests

sub_graphs.title: Capella: Block Processing State Transition
sub_graphs.description: Models the Capella-specific block processing sequence including execution payload validation and withdrawal processing

nodes.label: Capella Block Received
nodes.description: A signed beacon block for the Capella fork has been received for processing

nodes.label: Process Block Header
nodes.description: Validate and process beacon block header fields

nodes.label: Process Execution Payload Withdrawals
nodes.description: Verify withdrawals in execution payload match expected withdrawals from state, then apply balance changes

nodes.label: Validate Execution Payload
nodes.description: Verify parent hash, prev_randao, timestamp, and withdrawal root consistency against execution engine

nodes.label: Process Block Operations
nodes.description: Process attestations, deposits, voluntary exits, sync aggregate, and BLS-to-execution changes

nodes.label: Update Historical Summaries
nodes.description: Every SLOTS_PER_HISTORICAL_ROOT slots, append HistoricalSummary with block and state root accumulators

nodes.label: Block Processing Complete
nodes.description: All block processing steps completed, state updated

edges.label: Operations processed, update historical summaries if epoch boundary

sub_graphs.title: Capella: Execution Payload and Withdrawal Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rules applied to execution payloads and withdrawal operations in Capella

nodes.label: Execution Payload Pending Validation
nodes.description: Execution payload received, awaiting consistency checks

nodes.label: Verify Parent Hash Consistency
nodes.description: Check execution payload parent_hash matches latest execution payload header

nodes.label: Verify prev_randao Match
nodes.description: Check prev_randao in payload matches get_randao_mix for current epoch

nodes.label: Verify Timestamp Alignment
nodes.description: Check payload timestamp equals compute_timestamp_at_slot for current slot

nodes.label: Verify Withdrawals Root
nodes.description: Check withdrawals in payload match hash_tree_root of expected withdrawals from get_expected_withdrawals

nodes.label: Execution Payload Valid
nodes.description: All payload validation checks passed

nodes.label: Execution Payload Rejected
nodes.description: One or more validation checks failed, block rejected

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly state what happens if the execution engine returns an error during withdrawal processing versus returning an invalid payload status.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume execution engine errors during withdrawal verification cause the entire block to be rejected. This needs verification against the execution engine API spec.

ambiguities.text: The term 'eth1 withdrawal credentials' is used interchangeably with '0x01 prefix credentials' without clarifying if other eth1-type prefixes could exist in the future.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume only 0x00 (BLS) and 0x01 (eth1) prefixes are valid. Future prefixes would require a new fork specification.

implicit_assumptions.description: The execution engine is trusted to correctly process withdrawals and reflect balance changes on the execution layer.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Withdrawals could be acknowledged on the consensus layer but not executed on the execution layer, causing a consensus-execution layer state mismatch.

implicit_assumptions.description: The validator sweep will process all eligible validators within a reasonable number of blocks, given MAX_VALIDATORS_PER_WITHDRAWALS_SWEEP of 16384.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If the validator set grows very large, withdrawal latency could become excessive, delaying fund access for exiting validators.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker who does not possess the BLS withdrawal key cannot forge a valid BLS-to-execution credential change.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Unauthorized credential changes could redirect withdrawal funds to attacker-controlled addresses.
